gphotos.note: Empty = the pipeline auto-resolves the latest Photos release from APKMirror. The pipeline automatically applies a DEX startup guard to neutralize GmsCoreSupport checkUpdates NullPointerExceptions, enabling seamless compatibility with the newest Google Photos releases. To force a specific version, set GPHOTOS_VERSION in the environment (accepts 3-segment `7.76.0` or 4-segment `7.76.0.913939682`).
